name: Different Perspectives
source:
Welcome! You entered the university because you have a mission to accomplish. You can choose how you look. Decide on who will be your closest friend from them and save someone’s life! Be careful with your decisions, for it will affect your future.

This story contains a lot of inspiring and encouraging words from the Bible. It compares the perspectives of man versus of God’s. Some were inspired by real life events testifying the wisdom and love of God. There is more than life on this earth!

“While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.”

2 Corinthians 4:18 (KJV)

[From Google Play]
